source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 70, fielded July 13-19, 2020.
method: Population is respondents who believe there is a lesson or set of lessons for humankind to learn from the coronavirus outbreak (COVIDLESSON1_W70 = yes), broken out by religious tradition (F_RELTRAD). Share of that subgroup who believe the lesson(s) were sent by God (COVIDLESSON2_W70); refused and 'I do not believe in God' excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W70 variable.
